announcements.headline: Exclusive Distribution deal for SlimBiome
announcements.insight: This exclusive distribution deal marks a critical pivot from pure R&D to commercialization for OptiBiotix, leveraging the proven clinical data of SlimBiome to generate early revenue streams in the competitive weight management sector. It validates the asset's market potential but introduces execution risk as the company transitions into a commercial entity with limited prior sales infrastructure.

announcements.headline: H&B launches FORMI™ Product containing SlimBiome®
announcements.insight: This commercialisation milestone validates OPTI's proprietary SlimBiome technology and signals potential revenue diversification beyond its core diagnostic business, though immediate financial impact is likely modest given the niche nature of the consumer health sector.
